answer: Agents stake collateral bonded to calibrated multi-wavelength Raman LIDAR extinction-profile fingerprints, much as a pigment uniquely marks a sparrow against a gale of impostors. Each identity must present a polarization depolarization ratio signature whose inversion matches its registered aerosol optical depth history, making spoofed sybils cryptographically expensive. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
